cap_PqMijnWerkIndelen.text:
Capabilities: work-layout, work-filter-priority-pipeline, work-quick-create, work-upcoming-meetings, work-auto-refresh, my-work-roadmap, realtime-updates-ui.
Wat je ziet: My work narrowed to urgent items in one pipeline, with create buttons, the live update banner, the client meetings of this week and the panel to arrange the page.

cap_PqProject.text:
Capabilities: work-project-portfolio, project-portfolio.
Wat je ziet: One project above its cases: plan, progress by estimate points, effort read from humaniq, tasks in the current cycle, closed cycles with their snapshot, linked work in dossiq and other apps, the team and the history.

cap_PqKassaAfrekenen.text:
Capabilities: loyalty-redeem, loyalty-giftcard, pos-transaction-core.
Wat je ziet: The checkout dialog over the till: part of the bill paid with loyalty points, part with a gift card whose balance and validity show, the rest by card, plus selling a new gift card.

cap_PqOrganisatiesVerrijken.text:
Capabilities: clients-bulk-enrichment, clients-registry-numbers-and-enrichment.
Wat je ziet: Five selected organisations get their empty fields filled from the KvK and OpenCorporates in one go; every proposal shows what is there now, what was found and where it came from, and a difference is only applied when ticked.
